wholeCurrentVsB007v4CandidateDeltas.before: The learner can explain the formation of coordinate bonds between a central atom or ion and ligands using unoccupied orbitals at the central atom or ion and lone pairs at the ligand, and interpret this using the Fehling test as an example.
